enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Intelligence +6: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Intelligence.
Insightful Charisma +6: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Charisma.
Insightful Evocation Focus +4: +4 Insight bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
Insightful Wizardry +145: +145 Insight bonus to spell points.
Legendary Demonic Shield: Each time you are hit in melee combat there is a chance that a shield of demonic energy will grant you a +240 Profane bonus to temporary hit points.
Legendary Deadly Diabolist: 2 Pieces Equipped: Your Summons, Charmed Monsters, and Hirelings gain +12 to all Ability Scores.
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
